description: The convention-D cyclotomic exponent is 3A-1 minus two per neutron. Substituting a free symbol for hecke_symbolic.z_markov shows the z-count is 3A-1 in both frames -- convention independent by construction, and exactly what the convention-C derivation counts. Substituting z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) then gives (q^2+1)^(3A-1) naively, of which exactly 2N factors CANCEL against the numerator, leaving 3A-1-2N = 3Z+N-1. So 3Z+N is NOT a strand count and NOT a peel count; it is arithmetic rewriting. This REFUTES the cyclotomic-aliasing hypothesis recorded in the 2026-08-24 prefactor audit, which guessed at extra per-frame sources; the mechanism is cancellation. The round-trip validity gate is asserted first because a first attempt at this measurement used a mismatched q symbol and produced a coincidentally-correct z-count from a meaningless expression. Scope-(a): these four configurations under bring_color_weighted.

convention.anchor: NONE enters the computation: tr_M_atomic is exact in symbolic q and every number here is a polynomial degree or a factor multiplicity. The top-level q0Anchor/q0Value are the ambient WitnessBuilder stamp -- which pin this process ran under, not an input to any value below.

assertions.name: round_trip_reproduces_unpatched
assertions.note: GATE: substituting z_D back into the free-symbol expression must reproduce tr_M_atomic exactly. A first attempt used a bare sp.Symbol('q') against the module's sp.Symbol('q', positive=True) and silently measured a two-q expression. No degree is reported unless this holds.

assertions.name: z_count_is_3A_minus_1
assertions.note: convention-independent by construction (degree in a free symbol); confirms the C derivation's n_strands - 1 count

assertions.name: d_frame_exponent_is_3Z_plus_N_minus_1
assertions.note: the closed form is an interface-ON statement; with the interface off the z-count itself drops to 2A (A separate closures instead of one joint closure of 3A strands, a difference of A-1), so 3Z+N-1 is not expected to hold

assertions.name: cancellation_survives_interface_off
assertions.note: SEPARATION TEST vs qou-cxon Q1. The lone neutron carries 2N = 2 with NO inter-nucleon crossing, and D/T/3He still cancel exactly 2N with the interface switched off. So this cancellation is INTRA-NUCLEON -- it belongs to the neutron itself -- whereas Q1's factor 12 vanishes when the interface is off. Opposite dependence on the same switch: they are DIFFERENT objects, and the conjecture that they were the same is refuted.

assertions.name: cancellation_is_two_per_neutron
assertions.note: the whole of the C-vs-D exponent gap; proton (N=0) is the zero-cancellation control
